Usage and adaptations in Mosto键盘:
- Offline Chinese lexicon (`Keyboard/Resources/lexicon.bin`) is built and rescaled from
  `zi.dict.yaml`, `jichu.dict.yaml`, `duoyin.dict.yaml`, and `diming.dict.yaml`.
- Dual-section offline language model (`Keyboard/Resources/grammar.gram`, Section 1
  Viterbi sentence decoding and Section 2 context continuations) is distilled into the
  quantized `Mosto::GramV2` format from `wanxiang-lts-zh-hans.gram` and `zi.dict.yaml`.
- Modern English tech/brand display forms and supplemental English entries in
  `Keyboard/Resources/english.bin` are adapted from `en.dict.yaml`.
